hooks.command: if [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ]; then case "$TOOL_INPUT" in *grep*|*rg*|*find*|*fd*|*Glob*|*Grep*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: Knowledge graph exists at graphify-out/graph.json. Read graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md for god nodes, community structure, and surprising connections BEFORE searching raw files. Use /graphify query for targeted traversal."}}' ;; esac; fi

[ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: Knowledge graph exists. Read graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md for god nodes and community structure before searching raw files. Use /graphify query for targeted graph traversal."}}' || true

if [ -f graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md ]; then case "$TOOL_INPUT" in *wiki/*|*raw/*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: Before reading wiki/raw files, check graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md for structural context. God nodes and community clusters may reveal connections this file participates in."}}' ;; esac; fi

case "$TOOL_INPUT" in *.md*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"obsidian-skills: Use Obsidian Flavored Markdown — wikilinks [[page-slug]] for internal links, proper frontmatter with type/title/tags/related/created/updated fields. See .claude/skills/obsidian-skills/skills/obsidian-markdown/SKILL.md for syntax reference."}}' ;; *.base*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"obsidian-skills: Use Obsidian Bases YAML syntax — filters, formulas, views. See .claude/skills/obsidian-skills/skills/obsidian-bases/SKILL.md for reference."}}' ;; *.canvas*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"obsidian-skills: Use JSON Canvas spec — nodes with 16-char hex IDs, edges with fromNode/toNode. See .claude/skills/obsidian-skills/skills/json-canvas/SKILL.md for reference."}}' ;; esac

case "$TOOL_INPUT" in *wiki/entities/*|*wiki/comparisons/*|*wiki/synthesis/*|*raw/sources/*) [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: Wiki content changed. Run /graphify --update after finishing all edits to refresh the knowledge graph."}}' ;; esac
